text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes! Fukukitaru does it again! 
Good fortune arrives on the stage of the 
Kiku, too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see that?! My Great Good Luck 
Running Style cut right through the pack! 
It feels like I'm a whole new me!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I gathered up all that luck and ran, and 
then my body got so hot... What in the 
world just happened!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it must be! Things normally never go 
this well for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You could say that today, I was the avatar 
of Happy! None other than the Great Gongen 
of Happy herself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fuwhahahaha! This is the power of a god! 
Good fortune is the one and only power 
that leads to the top!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As long as we keep riding this wave of 
good fortune, our future is sure to be 
secure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, which race should we aim for 
next?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"From the Japan Cup to the Arima Kinen! 
With this momentum, shall we blast through 
and conquer both?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so? Reborn as I am 
now, it seems like it'd be an easy win, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The Kinko Sho...? Next spring's...? 
You've set your sights quite far ahead."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, fair enough! I'll let you off easy 
with just this for this year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On instinct, I decided to keep a bit of 
distance. Something about Matikane 
Fukukitaru's behavior seemed awfully 
suspicious...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hoheeh? What are you talking about~? My 
third eye has opened! I'm as fine as a 
sunfish in the sea!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm off to do the interview. What 
should I talk about~? Maybe about meeting 
God~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her steps felt unusually light and airy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on—Matikanefukukitaru 
gradually began to act strangely.
